einzeiler: A college student witnesses campus police interrupt a lecture in 2009.
kurzfassung: In the fall of 2009, a college student sits in a crowded lecture hall in Southern California. Suddenly, three campus police officers and a man in a suit enter the room. The officers speak to the professor, prompting an immediate realization from the student.
stichpunkte: Setting the scene in a Southern California college lecture hall in fall 2009
Campus police officers and a man in a suit enter the room unexpectedly
Officers speak to the professor at the front of the hall
A student in the audience immediately anticipates what is about to happen
beschreibung:
In the fall of 2009, a college student sat in a crowded lecture hall in Southern California, listening to his professor. Suddenly, the doors swung open and three campus police officers walked in, followed by a man in a suit. The officers went over and whispered something to the professor, who leaned into his microphone. And before the professor even said a word, the student’s stomach dropped – because he’d just realized what was about to happen.
